slow_internet.solution: Try restarting your router and checking your connection settings.

app_crashing.symptom: The app keeps crashing on startup.
app_crashing.solution: Update the app to the latest version and restart your device.

battery_drain.symptom: My phone battery drains very quickly.
battery_drain.solution: Lower your screen brightness and close background apps.

screen_flickering.solution: Check for loose cables or update your display drivers.

printer_not_working.solution: Make sure it’s connected properly and try reinstalling the printer drivers.

bluetooth_not_connecting.solution: Turn Bluetooth off and on again and re-pair the devices.

overheating_laptop.symptom: My laptop gets very hot quickly.
overheating_laptop.solution: Clean the vents and ensure the fans are working properly.

frozen_computer.solution: Try a hard reboot by holding the power button for 10 seconds.

no_sound.symptom: There’s no sound coming from my computer.
no_sound.solution: Check your sound settings and ensure your speakers are plugged in.

wifi_not_found.symptom: My device can’t find any Wi-Fi networks.
wifi_not_found.solution: Restart your router and make sure Wi-Fi is enabled on your device.

email_not_syncing.solution: Check your internet connection and re-enter your email credentials.

black_screen.symptom: My computer turns on but the screen stays black.
black_screen.solution: Check your monitor cables and try a different display.

keyboard_not_working.solution: Reconnect or replace the keyboard and update drivers if necessary.

mouse_lag.symptom: The mouse movement is laggy and unresponsive.
mouse_lag.solution: Replace the batteries or update the mouse drivers.

slow_startup.symptom: My computer takes forever to start up.
slow_startup.solution: Disable unnecessary startup programs and scan for malware.

camera_not_working.solution: Ensure privacy settings allow access and reinstall the camera driver.

notifications_not_showing.symptom: I’m not receiving any notifications on my phone.
notifications_not_showing.solution: Check app notification settings and ensure Do Not Disturb is off.

files_not_downloading.symptom: I can’t download any files from the internet.
files_not_downloading.solution: Check your internet connection and clear your browser’s cache.

playback_issues.symptom: Videos are buffering or not playing properly.
playback_issues.solution: Lower the video quality or check your internet speed.

password_not_accepted.symptom: My password isn’t being accepted even though it's correct.
password_not_accepted.solution: Reset your password and ensure Caps Lock isn’t enabled.

system_update_fail.solution: Clear update cache and try manually installing the update.

unresponsive_app.symptom: An app freezes and doesn’t respond.
unresponsive_app.solution: Force close the app and reopen it.

screen_rotation_issue.symptom: My phone screen won’t rotate automatically.

voice_assistant_not_listening.symptom: The voice assistant isn’t responding to commands.
voice_assistant_not_listening.solution: Check microphone permissions and internet connection.

system_clock_wrong.symptom: My device shows the wrong time.
system_clock_wrong.solution: Set the time to update automatically using the internet.

no_internet_access.symptom: Wi-Fi is connected but there’s no internet access.
no_internet_access.solution: Restart the router and check with your ISP.

account_locked.symptom: My account is locked and I can't log in.
account_locked.solution: Follow the account recovery process and reset your password.

device_not_charging.symptom: My device won’t charge when plugged in.
device_not_charging.solution: Try a different charger and inspect the charging port.

contacts_missing.symptom: Some of my contacts have disappeared.
contacts_missing.solution: Check if contacts are synced and restore from a backup.

gps_not_accurate.symptom: My GPS location is wrong or inaccurate.
gps_not_accurate.solution: Calibrate your GPS and check location settings.

storage_full.symptom: My device says storage is full.
storage_full.solution: Delete unnecessary files and uninstall unused apps.

screen_burn_in.symptom: I notice ghost images on my screen.
screen_burn_in.solution: Use screen savers and enable dark mode.

app_updates_stuck.solution: Clear the app store cache and try again.

microphone_not_working.symptom: My microphone isn’t picking up any sound.
microphone_not_working.solution: Check input settings and ensure the mic isn’t muted.

wrong_language.symptom: My device switched to another language.
wrong_language.solution: Change the system language back in settings.

headphones_not_detected.symptom: Headphones plugged in but no sound is coming through.
headphones_not_detected.solution: Clean the headphone jack and check audio settings.

duplicate_photos.symptom: I have many duplicate photos cluttering my gallery.
duplicate_photos.solution: Use a duplicate photo remover app to clean up.

device_random_restarts.symptom: My device restarts by itself randomly.
device_random_restarts.solution: Check for software updates and scan for malware.

vpn_not_connecting.solution: Check VPN settings and try a different server location.

cloud_sync_failed.symptom: My files aren't syncing to the cloud.
cloud_sync_failed.solution: Ensure you are signed in and check available storage.

browser_crashing.solution: Clear browser cache and disable unnecessary extensions.
